ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE glslang plugin: GLSL programs compiled to SPIR-V
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The glslang plugin of OGRE 14.6.3 (Plugin_GLSLangProgramManager upstream), a plugin of the Ogre core library. It adds the program language "glslang": GLSL that glslang (the module glslang) compiles to SPIR-V for the Vulkan render system, which only takes SPIR-V. The RTSS writes its programs in this language on Vulkan. Local edits marked "DV edit" in src/OgreGLSLang.cpp.
